node.statement: Node 1.1.2 says exactly that A is the complement of B in the full index set {1,...,m}; hence {1,...,m} is the disjoint union B union A. Therefore the barycenter identity sum_i p_i w_i = 0 may be written as sum_{i in B} p_i w_i + sum_{i in A} p_i w_i = 0. By the definition B := {i : w_i = w_*}, the first sum is (sum_{i in B} p_i) w_* = q*w_*. Substitution gives q*w_* + sum_{i in A} p_i w_i = 0, and moving the first term gives -q*w_* = sum_{i in A} p_i w_i.
